outcome: Mothers' Postpartum Parenting Behavior Scale (PPBS) scores
Fathers' Postpartum Parenting Behavior Scale (PPBS) scores
cohort: 200 married individuals who had healthy babies.
finding: Mothers exhibited high parenting behavior scores while fathers showed moderate scores, with various demographic and marital factors, including desire for children, marital adjustment, and income level, influencing these behaviors, particularly mode of delivery for fathers.
mod_finding: Fathers' parenting behavior scores were lower following cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: During the postpartum period for parents who had healthy babies between February 2019 and September 2020.
